qualitative_activity_claims.claim: Dec-NH2 caused more than 50% MCF-7 cancer-cell lysis at 3.12 µmol L−1 after 2 h; the source table records the 24 h IC50 as 12.5 µmol L−1.

[Leu]10-Dec-NH2 achieved more than 50% MCF-7 lysis at 25 µmol L−1 after 2 h and at 12.5 µmol L−1 after 24 h; Dec-NH2 and [Leu]10-Dec-NH2 showed no significant MCF-10A cytotoxicity at about 100 µmol L−1 in the text/figure discussion.

[Leu]8-Dec-NH2 had no significant MCF-7 activity versus control but was cytotoxic to MCF-10A at the lowest tested concentration (25 µmol L−1); exact figure-derived normal-cell thresholds were not promoted to source-verified table rows.
